Definition: Rimmon, the name of a Syrian deity, also of five places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: The name is Rimmon, the name of a Syrian deity, also of five places in Palestine. You find the name in 1 Chronicles 4:32, "…their villages, Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen…", and again in 2 Kings 5:18 and 2 Samuel 4:2.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Rimmon matters because Scripture names even the false gods, so we can see them for what they are. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
